findings.title: Emitted Worker source was syntactically invalid in browsers
findings.correction: Serialize the nested function body and remove strict-mode eval formal parameter.

findings.title: Specialist run confirmation transition was unreachable
findings.correction: Add an exact positive specialist-only adapter that stages the existing confirmation dispatcher.

findings.title: Worker result could publish after source or dataset change
findings.correction: Snapshot source version/files/batch/mapping/mode and discard stale result or error.

findings.title: Separate child adoption lost parser lineage
findings.correction: Transfer the same bounded job ID and binding to the created child batch.

findings.title: Failed generation could report success
findings.correction: Short-circuit on the first failed group and return its failure.

findings.title: Composer could remain busy after generation settled
findings.correction: Reconcile busy state from committed specialist and model-coordinator props.

findings.title: Repair could consume unrelated source or runtime error
findings.correction: Require exact installed lineage source/binding and its own current runtime error.

findings.title: Concurrent message append could lose a turn
findings.correction: Perform load-normalize-append-put in one IndexedDB readwrite transaction.

findings.title: Old generated draft could become unbound after a later upload
findings.correction: Require a current specialist modelRunId/batch binding both when enabling confirmation and inside the existing runner.

findings.title: Custom-result verification could race React state
findings.correction: Poll the bounded result ID until the existing run settles.

findings.title: Zero-hyperedge run retained misleading result state
findings.correction: Clear generated result/result ID and report failure.

findings.title: Recovery references could outlive a real upload
findings.correction: Permanently yield restored references after observing current workspace files.

findings.title: Relationship prompt evidence omitted exact columns
findings.correction: Include bounded participating left/right columns and exactness evidence.

findings.title: Specialist UI did not expose actual run/apply lifecycle
findings.correction: Derive installed job states from existing runner/result/apply state.

findings.title: Whole-state saves are last-writer-wins across simultaneous tabs
findings.mitigation: Per-instance saves are serialized and the store exposes atomic saveMessage; cross-tab merge is deferred.

findings.title: Manual edits detach a draft from automatic repair lineage
findings.mitigation: Edited source still requires run/apply confirmations; reopen or regenerate a tracked draft for automatic repair.
